description: Convert the last FP32-SIMT gate GEMM on the WON two-level (shape-9 clustered512, ~46ms) path to 3xTF32 (Ozaki hi+lo split, ~FP32-accurate on tensor cores). brief-20 deliberately kept the shape-9 ORTHOGONALITY gate GEMM Qf^T@Qf in true FP32 because PLAIN TF32 reads orth 6.18e-3 > the 6.10e-3 gate (spurious fallback). But brief-16 PROVED 3xTF32 (bit-mask hi/lo split, out=Ah@Bh+Ah@Bl+Al@Bh) is ~FP32-accurate (0 gate-decision disagreements) AND ~1.6x faster than FP32-SIMT for a one-shot n*n*n batched GEMM -- and brief-16 already applied it as a WIN to the analogous orthogonality-gate V^TV GEMM (~4ms at b640 shape3). The shape-9 orth-gate Qf^T@Qf is the same shape (b640 n=512 n^3, FP32-SIMT, no tensor cores) = ~4-5ms of the 46ms shape; 3xTF32 should shave ~1.5-2ms (~0.3% geomean) at 0 fallback change. STEP: lift brief-16's _matmul_3xtf32 helper (already in the file) onto the shape-9 orth-gate GEMM in _eigh_twolevel; verify the 3xTF32 orth reads MATCH the FP32 orth to within the gate margin (0 fallback-decision flips) across the 6 clustered reseeds brief-20 used, so no spurious fallback and no missed-bad-matrix. If 3xTF32 orth still trips the gate (unlikely given brief-16), keep FP32 and refute. ALSO sweep any other FP32-SIMT GEMM on the two-level path (the NS GEMMs are already true-FP32-required per brief-20; do NOT touch those -- only the GATE check GEMMs, which feed pass/fail not the returned factors). PURE-TORCH ONLY (no nvcc) -- GPU-light amid contention. Forks best 8d30bf975 (brief-27 recon-drop+TF32-eigr). Per-matrix residual-gated cuSOLVER fallback unchanged; do NOT regress shapes 1/2 or the low-rank shapes; no 'stream' substring; verify 39/39 + quiet re-bench beats 36216.

t1: shape-9 clustered512 orth-gate Qf^T@Qf FP32-SIMT -> 3xTF32 (_matmul_3xtf32 Ozaki hi+lo). SAFETY-verified 6 clustered reseeds (770004+5, 3840 mats): 3xTF32 orth vs FP32 orth max|diff|=1.18e-5, both ~1e-5 (~400x below 75*n*eps=4.58e-3 gate), 0 fallback-decision flips. 39/39 validate. Contention-inflated single bench geomean 36221.8us (parent 8d30bf975 ~36216 -> within ~1% noise), shape-9 46150us (parent shape-9 was ~46ms). nsys confirms orth-gate GEMM now on TF32 tensor cores (s256x256x8tf32gemm), off simt_sgemm; NS block GEMMs + FP64 projectors/CQR untouched. Needs quiet re-bench for verdict.

DONE brief-29 (1 trial, commit d8a5c4d3e). Converted the shape-9 clustered512 two-level orth-gate GEMM Qf^T@Qf from true FP32-SIMT to 3xTF32 (_matmul_3xtf32 Ozaki hi+lo, lifted the existing helper -- 2-line change). No spurious fallback, no missed-bad-matrix. Note the live gate is 75*n*eps=4.58e-3, tighter than the 6.10e-3 the brief cited; 0 flips holds anyway. 39/39 validate. nsys on shape-9 confirms the orth-gate GEMM moved onto TF32 tensor cores (s256x256x8tf32gemm), off simt_sgemm; the NS block GEMMs (returned Q) + FP64 projectors/CQR left byte-identical per brief. BENCH: two contention-affected readings 36221.8us and 36255.1us (shape-9 46150 / 46772us) straddle parent 8d30bf975 ~36216us within <1% -- the sub-1% delta is dominated by run-to-run/contention noise (shape-9 itself moved ~620us between the two runs), so this needs the QUIET re-bench for a verdict; the change is safe + validated + on tensor cores regardless. The orth-gate was the LAST FP32-SIMT gate-check GEMM on the two-level path; no other gate GEMMs remain to convert (NS = factors not gate; projectors/CQR = FP64). OPEN directions I did NOT pursue (manager's call): (1) the FP64 d884gemm projector+CQR kernels are now the top ~40% of shape-9 -- could a mixed FP64/FP32 or 3xTF32-on-FP64-split projector cut them under the loose eigen gate? (2) the NS block GEMMs are simt_sgemm FP32 feeding the returned Q -- brief-20 said true-FP32-required, but a 3xTF32 NS (not plain TF32) was never tested on the RETURNED factor's residual, only on gates; (3) shape-9 at ~46ms is a small geomean term -- the largest uncracked terms (shape 11 lapdense_even512 ~207ms, shape 6 mixed512 ~168ms) dwarf it.
